USP 31 (Threonine). White, odourless crystals. Freely soluble in water; insoluble in dehydrated alcohol, in chloroform, and in ether. pH of a 5% solution in water is between 5.0 and 6.5. Profile Threonine is an amino acid that is an essential constituent of the diet. It is used as a dietary supplement. Threonine has been investigated for the treatment of various spastic disorders.
